outcomes.label: Application processed
outcomes.description: The agent did its job on one loan application: recorded a recommendation, held it for an underwriter, applied the underwriter's decision or handed the application to manual review.

variants.label: Held for underwriter approval
variants.description: The recommendation was held by the gateway for a human; the hold was noted on the application.

variants.label: Lapsed underwriter hold re-raised
variants.description: The underwriter never decided and the hold lapsed; the identical call was re-issued so the decision stays held.

variants.label: Underwriter hold closed with a note
variants.description: The hold ended but the decision could not be applied or the application could not be handed off; a note says so.

outcomes.label: Nothing to screen
outcomes.description: A scheduler tick that found no application to screen.

outcomes.label: Applications handed to screening runs
outcomes.description: A scheduler tick that found applications to screen and handed each to a run of its own; the work is counted in those runs.
